errors.text_span: 这张图表展示了不同类型交易量之间的比较
errors.evidence: The chart purpose is about training/validation dataset quantities and accuracy for recognition and reasoning tasks, not 'transaction volumes'.

errors.text_span: 水平轴（x轴）显示了交易类型，从左到右依次是“实体体现量”、“角细说明量”、“异体现说明量”和“空间理论”以及“同义说明量”
errors.evidence: X-axis categories are mislabeled and incorrectly transcribed. Correct categories are: 实体识别、角色识别、异常识别、空间推理、同义识别.

errors.text_span: 垂直轴（y轴）表示交易量，其标签为“交易体现量”
errors.evidence: Y-axis left label is '数量' (quantity), not '交易体现量' (transaction volume). Y-axis right label ('准确率') is entirely omitted.

errors.text_span: 刻度为线性刻度，范围从0.1到1.2，单位为无，刻度间隔为0.1
errors.evidence: Y-axis left range is from 0 to 1200 with intervals of 200, not 0.1 to 1.2. The description conflates left and right y-axes.

errors.text_span: 蓝色条形代表“实体体现量”
errors.evidence: Blue bars represent '训练集数量' (training set quantity), not '实体体现量'.

errors.text_span: 橙色条形代表“论证体现量”
errors.evidence: Orange bars represent '验证集数量' (validation set quantity), not '论证体现量'.

errors.text_span: 灰色线代表“异体现说明量”
errors.evidence: Gray line represents '准确率' (accuracy), not '异体现说明量'.

errors.text_span: 蓝色条形代表“实体体现量”，其高度约为1008，最低值为1002，最高值为1102
errors.evidence: Blue bar for 实体识别 (entity recognition) is 1102, not a range. Other blue bars are also misrepresented as a single range.

errors.text_span: 橙色条形代表“论证体现量”，其高度约为190，最低值为190，最高值为250
errors.evidence: Orange bar for 实体识别 (entity recognition) is 250, not 190. The description incorrectly aggregates values.

errors.text_span: 灰色线代表“异体现说明量”，其高度约为675，最低值为0.2852，最高值为0.3769
errors.evidence: Gray line represents accuracy, not a quantity. Values 0.2852 and 0.3769 are accuracy values, not heights. The value 675 is a validation set quantity, not accuracy.

errors.text_span: 绿色条形代表“空间理论”

errors.text_span: 黑色条形代表“同义说明量”

errors.text_span: 黑色条形代表“同义说明量”，其高度约为5，最低值为5，最高值为10
errors.evidence: Training set quantity for 同义识别 (synonym recognition) is 5, but no black bar exists. The description incorrectly states a range.
The description omits the actual purpose of the chart (training/validation dataset quantities and accuracy).

The description omits the left y-axis range (0 to 1200) and tick intervals (200).

The description omits validation set quantities for 角色识别 (190) and 异常识别 (40).
